episodeTitle.en: Why not asking for what you want is holding you back | Kenneth Berger (exec coach, first PM @Slack)
episodeTitle.zh: 为何不主动争取想要的东西会阻碍你前进 | 肯尼斯·伯格（执行教练，Slack首位产品经理）

guestBioOfficial.en: Kenneth Berger coaches startup leaders on how to prevent burnout, advocate for their desired lifestyle, and make a meaningful impact on the world. He’s spent more than  20 years in the tech industry, is a former founder backed by top investors, and was the first product manager at Slack. Kenneth’s core mission is to help startup leaders change the world by learning to ask for what they want, living with integrity, and building genuine relationships even with the people they find most challenging. Currently he is writing a book, Ask for What You Want, in which he aims to share his actionable strategies for creating change in the world. In our conversation, we explore: • Why asking for what you want is so impactful
guestBioOfficial.zh: 肯尼斯·伯格为初创企业领导者提供指导，帮助他们预防职业倦怠、倡导理想生活方式，并为世界创造积极影响。他在科技行业深耕逾20年，曾是获得顶级投资者的初创公司创始人，也是Slack的首位产品经理。肯尼斯的核心使命是帮助初创企业领导者通过学会主动争取想要的东西、秉持诚信原则以及与最具挑战性的人建立真诚关系来改变世界。目前，他正在撰写《勇于争取》一书，旨在分享其推动世界变革的实用策略。在对话中，我们将探讨：• 主动争取想要的东西为何具有深远影响

title.en: Why not asking for what you want is holding you back | Kenneth Berger (exec coach, first PM @Slack)
title.zh: 为何不主动争取想要的东西会阻碍你前进 | 肯尼斯·伯格（执行教练，Slack首位产品经理）

summary.en: Kenneth centers his coaching on the idea of "ask for what you want," noting that voicing desires out loud dramatically increases the odds of getting them. He frames sustainable startup work as avoiding both burnout and sellout. The episode distills lessons from his decade as an operator and years as a coach into practical advice for ambitious leaders.
summary.zh: 肯尼斯把教练工作的核心放在"开口要你想要的"这一理念上，指出把愿望大声说出来会大幅提高实现的概率。他把可持续的创业工作定义为既不倦怠也不妥协。本期将他十余年运营者与多年教练的经验，提炼成对雄心勃勃的领导者的实用建议。
